page_title: WHU 0-2 CRY | West Ham v Crystal Palace 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

90+2' Poor challenge! Carlos Soler (West Ham) is penalised for tripping and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Crystal Palace, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Will Hughes makes his way off the pitch and Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) comes on as his replacement.
90' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta will be replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
89' 0 - 2 Goal! Lukasz Fabianski gets a hand on the penalty from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
88' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is going to take the penalty!

87' Lukasz Fabianski (West Ham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Bramall stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PENALTY! One of the players from Crystal Palace is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
87' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
85' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
83' Substitution. Edson Alvarez will be replaced by Luis Guilherme (West Ham).
82' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
81' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
80' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is given a yellow card by Thomas Bramall and because it's his second one today, the game is over for him.

79' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Fabianski thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
79' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
78' A substitution has been made. Eberechi Eze goes off and Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) comes on.
76' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sprays a pass out to Eberechi Eze, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
74' The total number of attempts is 5:8. The shots on goal statistics – 0:4.

70' What a great effort! Edson Alvarez (West Ham) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
70' Danny Ings (West Ham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
70' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Carlos Soler (West Ham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Ismaila Sarr cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Carlos Soler (West Ham) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
67' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to West Ham.
65' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
63' Carlos Soler (West Ham) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
61' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots low towards goal, but Lukasz Fabianski makes a magnificent save!
59' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Edson Alvarez (West Ham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
56' Lucas Paqueta goes off the pitch and Danny Ings (West Ham) comes on.
56' Graham Potter has decided to substitute Emerson and he is replaced by Lewis Orford (West Ham).
56' Substitution. Aaron Cresswell makes way for Oliver Scarles (West Ham).

55' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
54' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Crystal Palace have been awarded a free kick.
54' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball in, but Lukasz Fabianski comfortably gathers the ball.

48' 0 - 1 GOAL! Eberechi Eze finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from mid range. It’s 0:1.
47' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Half-time substitution. Graham Potter decided to make a change. Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) is replaced by Carlos Soler.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Thomas Bramall has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
45+1' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) tackles a bit over-zealously and Thomas Bramall blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to West Ham.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
43' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
42' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
40' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Fabianski punches the ball away.
40' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes it short.

39' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
36' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) and Ismaila Sarr try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
35' A cross into the box from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
34' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
33' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
33' 2:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 0:2.

30' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
27' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
26' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham will take a free kick.

25' Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a fantastic save! Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
24' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
24' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul after Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) hacks down one of his opponents. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
24' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
23' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Good work from Crystal Palace as they win a corner.
20' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
18' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
17' The free kick is delivered by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
16' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Crystal Palace will take a free kick near the side line.
14' The free kick into the penalty area from Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is cleared.
13' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Thomas Bramall signals a foul. West Ham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
12' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
12' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a short corner kick.

12' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
9' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot well wide of the left post.
6' A lofted cross from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
4' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
2' Neat passing move from Crystal Palace in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
Thomas Bramall will officiate today.
